plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Atomic-commit Git workflow skills: folding changes into the right commit (amend/edit/fixup), conflict resolution, reflog-based undo, and bisect debugging, plus shared conventions (rebase-over-merge, stashing, commit-message style).

plugins.name: php-style
plugins.description: PHP code conventions centred on object calisthenics: one level of indentation, no else, wrapped primitives, first-class collections, no train wrecks, no abbreviations, small entities, no getters or setters, plus the PHP specifics that support them.
